:::{#rem-numerator-layout}
#### Numerator layout

Some sources use the numerator layout (@def-jacobian-matrix) throughout,
so that their derivative of a vector-valued function is the Jacobian matrix,
the transpose of the derivative used in these notes.
In numerator layout, the derivative of a scalar-valued function is a row:
the row-vector derivative (@def-row-vector-derivative).
Check a source's layout before combining its formulas with these.

:::
